reviews.x: While this product did soften my feet it was not worth the horrible rash that Followed. I used the 1st pair without any problem. 1 week later did the same exact thing and now I can’t even sleep my feet itch so bad and look burned. On oral steroids and topical cream.

Cracked Heels will never be a problem for me again.  I have tried many items for the last 2 years including Vaseline to no avail.  This is the only thing I have found that works. It is like magic. LOVE it, fantastic product!

reviews.t: One size does not fit all
reviews.x: Not sure why you made these foot masks so small. Men definitely won’t be able to use these and although I am a woman, I am 6’2” and wear a size 13 shoe. I had to cut these to get them to go on. Not everyone fits your tiny mold. Very disappointed customer.

Finally a product that makes a difference!! I've tried what seems like every home remedy and cream out there, some work a little, most not at all on my really horrible dry cracked heals. This is the first product that is working both in the short term; my feet look baby smooth when I take them out of the "booties", and they have stayed fairly soft and moisturized for a few weeks. I am always barefoot, inside and outside and my feet take a beating, but now they look cancel worthy!! I did keep the

reviews.t: 5 days after use, I am on continuous anti-histamines and prednisone
reviews.x: I am trying to warn others about this product. I have never had a reaction to a lotion, but these have caused my feet to look burned. I bought these slippers as a treat and am paying dearly. My skin itches so badly, I have broken my skin from scratching. There is something in this that I am obviously allergic to and I have read the same thing from others on other sites. Walgreens is censoring comments, so there are likely more people reacting to this product than we know.
It works good. I leave it overnight and it makes my feet look so soft. (I tried leave for only 15 mins at the beginning and it made no difference on my feet so I leave it overnight)

Love these. Makes your feet feel great and soft. I am had on my feet and these will repair them quickly and add moisturizer back to soften. Only issue is i think they are a bit too small to get on and off and sometimes tear the sock. I have a size 11 foot and it doesn’t always clear the heal. I still give it a 5 star because it is still a great product

I usually buy this same product at CVS and love it!! Thought I would try it from this site where it was less$ and more convenient, 1 of the socks in each was almost impossible to open & although it may have been ok, would not buy again - would rather spend the extra$ to buy at CVS/elsewhere where the results are great.

I wish I would have taken a picture.  My husband works construction and his feet and hands are horrible.  I bought both mask after my daughter bought one from Target and we used it.  These are so easy to use, just slip on and we put socks over top to get maximum help.  His feet are normally awful.  We left them on longer - dont know if needed but figured he did - took the mask off an hour later and worked in the lotion that was left.  His feet are so much better than before which is why I bought

Bought these for my youngest daughter’s upcoming birthday. They arrived yesterday. Because you get 5 in a pack my older daughter asked if she could try one so I gave her one. She just tried the foot mask booties and she loves them! She left them on for about 20-25 minutes while watching tv. After taking the booties off she rubbed in any remaining moisturizer on her feet and put on a pair of socks. She said they were a 10 out of 10 and she would definitely recommend them. I’m sure my youngest dau

It felt fine when the mask was on and then a few hours after I took it off my feet started burning and they were covered in little bumps. My dermatologist said there is a lot of chemicals in here that are bad for your skin and any of them could have caused the reaction.

Easy to use after shower, left it on longer because feet felt great. They were hurting. My hands were also better after rubbing in as suggested.  I'm going to use again soon since my feet are cracked. Love it.
Easy to use although the tape to secure them was ineffective.  I put a pair of socks over them to keep them on my feet.  The lotion felt good and I got a few minutes of pampering while using them.

I bought this at my local grocery store and I usually never write amazon reviews despite ordering from them all the time but ohmygoodness. My feet are so soft. and feet freak me out but. WOW. i am laying in bed and am amazed by how soft my feet are and it’s been 3 days since I used it and they’re softer than they were since I first used the mask. My feet were really dry because I go to school in Oklahoma and it’s just cold and gross but wow. amazed. 10/10 recommend.

These work great for me.  However, putting my feet into a gooey cold gel is not my favorite experience.  I started putting the unopened package in a bowl of hot water to heat it up a little before I put them on.  Then I  put socks over it and leave it on for a half hour (instead of 10 minutes).  The socks help keep in the heat a bit and it feels more comfortable and I think it moisturizes better too.

I love these masks! I use them once a month or so for some deep skin treatment after a home pedi when my feet really need some TLC, so not sure about the rashes that I’ve seen from other posters. Maybe they’re suffering from too frequent use? I use these immediately after using a natural pumice stone and my skin goes from calloused and dry to super smooth! Can’t beat these for the price!

As I have gotten older I developed dry feet and cracked heels.  The Cica foot mask product gave my feet immediate relief on the first use.  I have started using them once a week, and my feet are soft ... no cracked heels any longer.
Heard a lot of good things about these things. Bought a set. I'm sure if I had feet the size of a pack of cigarettes they would work great. Dont waste your time if you have even a remotely large foot
I love these pampering boots for dry hot feet! But a nice way to relax.. sometimes I put a pair of socks over them and wear them for a long time
Save your money and squirt some lotion of any variety into a produce bag and wrap it around your feet. It is the same exact experience.
Left my feet red and itchy.  I may have had an allergic reaction

Good golly these things are awesome. I was gifted these by my husbands grandmother and originally was a little put off by them... she can have some wild ideas. But to my surprise once I tried these bad boys on I knew they were going to solve all my problems. Now I’m not saying I have the ugliest feet around... but let’s just say that ain’t great. This foot mask completely transformed the way my feet look and feel. Contemplating getting into the foot pic business after these results!

I actually purchased the mask at the grocery store but don’t want others to have the same experience as me. I’ve never had this reaction to anything before. I’m miserable. Can’t even sleep. Seriously amazed at how awful this is and honestly the product didn’t even feel like it did anything for my feet. I get better results just using regular lotion and wearing a pair of socks. Minus the rash.

First use was easy- I have Super calloused feet.  Used before bed for recommended time.  Feet were soft but back to normal mid-day.  Second use I slept in the booties.  Soft feet but about the same amount of time until back to normal.  The exception:  24 hours after sleeping in them, I developed massive case of hives on both feet.  If you are prone to dermatitis, don’t use.

So glad I found this item. Nothing works better, you clean your feet, put these on, and relax, read, whatever, 20 minutes later I take them off, rub the excess in really good, and voila!,  It's like a foot spa at home, my feet are soft, good to look at, and it lasts awhile. My whole family uses them now, and my parents love them. Thank you for making this great product! :)

claims.text: Many reviewers say the product makes their feet noticeably soft and works on dry, cracked heels where other products failed.
Several reviewers report a painful burning rash or itching reaction after use, some requiring medication.
Some reviewers find the masks too small, especially for larger feet, and hard to get on or keep on.
Reviewers note the product is easy to use, often worn with socks over top and left on longer than the suggested time.
A few reviewers mention packaging or fit issues, such as hard-to-open socks or tearing.
